Frederick stared at the glowing runes, the weight of eternity pressing against his mortal heart. The draft intensified, carrying the scent of ozone and ancient dust. He realized that immortality was not a gift, but a cage—a solitary confinement from which no one could escape. With a trembling hand, he did not reach for the vial of ingredients. Instead, he pulled a small, flint striker from his pocket. He struck it against the stone altar, igniting the dry parchment. As the runes curled into ash, the hidden chamber began to collapse, sealing the secret away forever. Frederick walked out into the sunlight, choosing the fleeting beauty of a finite life over the endless void of forever.

The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.
